The Subtask Name: Identify the dinosaur Featured Article promoted in November 2016
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.95
  agent_explanation: The Planner analyzes the initial task and decides to engage WebSurfer to search for the specific Wikipedia page listing November 2016 Featured Articles, providing specific search queries and instructions.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the Planner selects the wrong agent or provides incorrect search parameters, the WebSurfer may retrieve irrelevant data, making it difficult to locate the specific dinosaur article.
      severity: 0.85
      if_from_agent_wrong: The search might miss the target page or return incorrect results, leading to wasted steps.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer will perform searches that do not yield the required information about the November 2016 dinosaur FA.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.90
  agent_explanation: WebSurfer executes the search and returns the search results (viewport text and metadata) to the Planner, who then analyzes the findings to determine the next step.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If WebSurfer fails to extract the correct text from the viewport or misinterprets the search results, the Planner will base its analysis on flawed data.
      severity: 0.75
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner might miss the link to the "Promoted in November 2016" section or misidentify the dinosaur article.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner will make an incorrect decision about which page to open next or which article to investigate.

- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.92
  agent_explanation: Based on the initial search results, the Planner refines the strategy and instructs WebSurfer to open the specific "Wikipedia:Featured articles promoted in 2016" page to verify the November entries.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If the Planner repeatedly sends the same instruction without accounting for the viewport position, it may cause WebSurfer to re-fetch the same top-of-page content without scrolling.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer will repeatedly load the same section of the page, failing to reveal the November 2016 data.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer will waste resources fetching the same page state, delaying the discovery of the target information.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.88
  agent_explanation: WebSurfer attempts to locate the November section but reports that the viewport is still at the top, providing the Planner with the current state of the page.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If WebSurfer incorrectly reports the viewport position or fails to see the "Promoted in November 2016" link in the sidebar, the Planner cannot adjust the navigation strategy.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner might assume the section is missing entirely rather than just out of view.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner might decide to search again instead of scrolling or anchoring to the specific section.

- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.94
  agent_explanation: The Planner instructs WebSurfer to use the browser's "Find" function or anchor to the "Promoted in November 2016" section to bypass the scrolling issue.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the Planner assumes the section exists but it doesn't (due to a data issue in previous steps), WebSurfer will fail to find it.
      severity: 0.80
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer will search for a non-existent section, leading to a dead end.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer will report failure to find the section, stalling the task.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: WebSurfer repeatedly loads the page (simulating scrolling or finding) and reports the visible content, allowing the Planner to deduce the state.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If WebSurfer keeps loading the same page state without changing the viewport or using the find function, it creates a loop of identical feedback.
      severity: 0.65
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner receives no new information, leading to repeated instructions.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner may become confused or issue redundant commands, wasting time.

- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.96
  agent_explanation: Recognizing the difficulty in navigating the page via viewport, the Planner decides to directly access the nomination page for the suspected candidate (Giganotosaurus) to extract the nominator.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the Planner guesses the wrong article name (e.g., not Giganotosaurus), the direct link will be invalid or lead to the wrong data.
      severity: 0.90
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer will fetch the wrong nomination page, leading to incorrect data extraction.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The final answer will be based on the wrong article or no article at all.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.92
  agent_explanation: WebSurfer fetches the nomination page and returns the raw text containing the nominator's name and the promotion details, completing the data gathering phase.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If WebSurfer misreads the text (e.g., confusing "Ian Rose" with "FunkMonk" due to similar formatting), the Planner will extract the wrong name.
      severity: 0.85
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner will conclude the wrong person was the nominator.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The final answer will be factually incorrect regarding the nominator.
